chunks: And in the narration of ʿUmar ibn Udhaynah, from a group who narrated it from both of them, peace be upon them, together:

“The slaughtered animal of a woman, if she performs the slaughter well and mentions the Name, then there is no objection to eating it; likewise the boy, and likewise the blind person, if he is guided.”

key_terms.الْمَرْأَةِ: the woman whose act of slaughter is being ruled upon
key_terms.ذَبِيحَةَ: the slaughtered animal or slaughtered meat in question
key_terms.سَمَّتْ: pronounced the Name of Allah over the slaughter

ai.seo_question: Is it permissible in Islam to eat an animal slaughtered by a woman, a child, or a blind person?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a fiqh ruling on the validity of slaughter performed by a woman, a boy, and a blind person. It establishes that proper slaughter and mentioning Allah’s Name are the essential conditions, and that the blind person’s slaughter is valid when he is properly directed.
